_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Mixing up the vowels in bad, bed, bid and but

segments.text: Bad, Bed, Bid, But. Watch my mouth.
Repeat after me. Bad, Bed, Bid, But.

native.hook: a, e, i: farkı duyuyor musun?
native.caption: “bad”, “bed”, “bid” ve “but” arasındaki fark sadece ünlü sesinde. Türkçede olmayan a sesi için ağzını geniş aç. Carlos hocanın ağzına bak, sessizlikte tekrar et. Lexkite uygulamasında devam et.

en.hook: Can you hear a, e, i?
en.caption: The only difference between “bad”, “bed”, “bid” and “but” is the vowel. Open your mouth wide for the a sound that Turkish does not have. Watch Carlos’s mouth, then repeat in the pause. Keep going in the Lexkite app.
